_doc: Arena scoring rules. arena.py reads this on every run, so editing a number here rescores the whole ledger.
Everything is in US dollars at API list price. Net = value earned - API cost. Leagues rank setups by net dollars per run.
values_usd is the dial for how much quality is worth against spend. Raise verified_finding and an expensive model
has more room to earn its price; lower it and the cheapest model that is still right wins every league.
_values_rationale: Set 2026-10-16 from measured costs: Haiku auditor run $0.002-0.01, Sonnet verifier run $0.06-0.09, main Opus turn ~$0.19.
verified_finding 0.50: a Sonnet auditor (~10x Haiku's cost) wins only if it finds one more real defect every ~10 runs;
Fable (~100x) almost never does on grep-level work. That is the mild price disincentive, set by value, not by penalty.
false_finding -0.25: a false finding costs one verifier run plus a share of a main turn. Half the reward puts the
reporting bar at one-in-three odds, which favours recall: the verifier filters auditor noise (CLAUDE.md doctrine).
missed_planted -1.00: more than any run can save by skipping checks; a whole Haiku run costs under $0.01.
clean 0.10 x trust: a CLEAN is the common case and cannot be checked alone, so it pays little until canaries back it.
verdict_right 0.25 / verdict_wrong -1.00: a right verdict must cover a ~$0.07 Sonnet run; a wrong one reaches Charlie.

prices_usd_per_mtok._as_of: 2026-10-06 list prices (claude-api skill model table). cache_read is the per-MTok read price.
